body:
## Quick answer

A **chanderi kurta set** is made from chanderi – a light, slightly sheer fabric from Madhya Pradesh, woven from cotton, silk or a cotton-silk mix, with a soft natural sheen. It is breathable enough for summer and dressy enough for festivals. Look for a **lined kurta**, clear fabric details (cotton chanderi or silk chanderi), and handwork such as embroidery or cutwork. A good 3-piece chanderi set usually costs **$45–$70** abroad.

## What is chanderi?

Chanderi is named after the town of Chanderi in Madhya Pradesh, where it has been woven for centuries. It is known for being **lightweight, airy and glossy** at the same time. Read the full history in [What is chanderi fabric?](/blog/what-is-chanderi-fabric-how-to-style-a-chanderi-kurta-set/)

| Type | Feel | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| Cotton chanderi | Soft, matte-to-light sheen, very breathable | Office, day events, summer |
| Silk chanderi | Glossy, more formal | Festivals, puja, weddings |
| Cotton-silk chanderi | Balanced shine and comfort | Most occasions – the safest choice |

## How to spot good chanderi

1. **Light and crisp, not plasticky** – it should feel airy, not stiff or shiny like polyester.
2. **Slight transparency** – real chanderi is a little sheer, so a good kurta is **lined**.
3. **Fabric named clearly** – "cotton chanderi" or "silk chanderi", not just "chanderi look".
4. **Handwork** – embroidery, cutwork or zari buttis add value and last longer than prints.

## How to style a chanderi kurta set

| Occasion | How to wear it |
|---|---|
| Office | Pastel or white chanderi kurta, straight pants, small studs, a light dupatta folded on one shoulder |
| Festivals & puja | Coral, pink or yellow chanderi with gold jhumkas and embroidered juttis |
| Wedding day functions (haldi, mehendi) | Bright chanderi with a contrast dupatta |
| Evening | Add a statement dupatta (organza or gota) and a clutch |

Our [coral pink chanderi kurta set](/products/coral-pink-chanderi-hand-embroidered-kurta-pant-dupatta-set/) has a hand-embroidered yoke and a cutwork dupatta – easy to dress up or down.

## Care tips

- Dry clean for silk chanderi; gentle cold hand wash is fine for many cotton chanderi pieces – always follow the label.
- Do not wring – press out water gently.
- Iron on low heat, inside out, to protect embroidery.
- Store folded in a cotton bag, away from direct sunlight.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is chanderi good for summer?**
Yes. Cotton chanderi is light and breathable, which makes it one of the best festive fabrics for hot weather.

**Is chanderi see-through?**
It is slightly sheer, so good chanderi kurtas come with a lining.

**What is the difference between chanderi and cotton?**
Chanderi is a fine, light weave with a natural sheen, often blended with silk. Regular cotton is softer and matte.

**Can I wear a chanderi kurta set to the office?**
Yes – choose pastel or white cotton chanderi with straight pants and minimal jewellery.
